definitions.explanation: The series of vertebrae extending from the skull to the pelvis, enclosing the spinal cord and providing structural support.

notes:
{脊椎|せきつい} is the technical/medical term for the spine or vertebral column. In everyday conversation, ⟦{背骨|せぼね}→背骨：17397_sebone⟧ (backbone) is far more common.

COMPOUNDS:
- {脊椎|せきつい}{動物|どうぶつ}: vertebrate (animal with a spine)
- {脊椎|せきつい}⟦{損傷|そんしょう}→損傷：21079_sonshou⟧: spinal injury
- {脊椎|せきつい}カリエス: spinal tuberculosis
- {脊椎|せきつい}⟦{矯正|きょうせい}→矯正：14784_kyousei⟧: spinal correction/chiropractic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{背骨|せぼね}→背骨：17397_sebone⟧: backbone (everyday, conversational)
- {脊柱|せきちゅう}: spinal column (technical, refers to the entire column)
- ⟦{脊髄|せきずい}→脊髄：16638_sekizui⟧: spinal cord (the nerve tissue inside the spine — not the bones)

REGISTER:
Used primarily in medical, scientific, and formal contexts. In casual speech, say ⟦{背骨|せぼね}→背骨：17397_sebone⟧ instead.
